data: In fiscal 2023 (the year ended January 29, 2023), NVIDIA reported revenue of $26,974 million, gross profit of $15,356 million and income from operations of $4,224 million, according to its Form 10-K filed February 24, 2023. That gives a gross margin of about 56.9% and an operating margin of about 15.7%. Both were well below fiscal 2022, when revenue was $26,914 million, gross profit was $17,475 million (a 64.9% gross margin) and operating income was $10,041 million (a 37.3% operating margin). Cost of revenue rose to $11,618 million from $9,439 million, which squeezed the gross margin. Operating expenses grew to $11,132 million, including a one-time $1,353 million acquisition termination cost and higher research and development spending of $7,339 million. Without the termination charge, operating income would have been about $5,577 million, an operating margin of roughly 20.7%.
